description: Keep Daylite, the Mac CRM by Marketcircle, up to date: find, add and update contacts, companies, opportunities, projects and tasks, write notes, and start a workflow when a contact, company, opportunity or task is added or an opportunity changes.

daylite_new_company_trigger.description: Runs when a company is added to Daylite, with its email, phone, type and industry. Companies already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

daylite_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when a person is added to Daylite, with their email, phone and companies. Contacts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

daylite_new_opportunity_trigger.description: Runs when an opportunity is added to Daylite, with its state, probability, expected close and companies. Opportunities already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.creator: The user who created it, /v1/users/<id>
output.name: Name
output.state: open, won, lost, suspended or abandoned

daylite_new_task_trigger.description: Runs when a task is added to Daylite, with its due date, priority, status and links. Tasks already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.creator: The user who created it, /v1/users/<id>
output.status: open, in_progress, pending, deferred, done or cancelled
output.title: The title

daylite_opportunity_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an opportunity in Daylite changes, such as being won, lost or moved to another stage, with how it is now. Several changes between two checks start one run. Adding an opportunity doesn't start it.

output.creator: The user who created it, /v1/users/<id>
output.name: Name
output.state: open, won, lost, suspended or abandoned
